scope: Static inspection of existing unencrypted original kernel; no guest execution proof or Apple implementation bytes retained

static_steps.finding: Filter reads register0x45818 through AppleRegisterStream and preserves result in x21.
Mask status with0xfffffffe, and if nonzero write that mask directly to0x45818.
OR masked status into self+0x1b88 using OSBitOrAtomic.
Return whether accumulated pending word self+0x1b88 is nonzero.
Separate handler clears pending word with OSBitAndAtomic(0), retaining returned prior bits in x21.
Following a virtual eligibility check, bit20 gates direct frame_done(timestamp) call.
Read0x45004; bit10 must be set in accumulated status and returned0x70 mask zero to continue ready path.
Internal pointer/state and virtual calls intervene before swap_request_complete call. Register read/W1C does not prove this call was reached.
swap_request_complete has further state branching before direct swap_info_notify_dispatch call.

interpretation: W1C belongs to interrupt filter before deferred handler completion.
Existing failed47 main+0x45004 reads are consistent with reaching handler beyond early acknowledgement, but trace has no PC/caller and alternate callers were not exhaustively excluded.
A status read followed by equivalent W1C supports expected filter behavior, not successful pipeline notification or compositor consumption.
Virtual methods and internal state gates are not assigned unproven meanings.
No evidence supports bypassing guards or fabricating completion.

direct_kernel_patch_comparison.method: Mapped original kmod header text ranges using same __kmod_info/+0x10 name and __kmod_start relationship as patcher. Scanned all original global text pattern anchors for mac-mount/kprintf/AMX/code-signature patch families with their exact masks/alignment. PPL patch range disjoint. Data/cstring patches disjoint from audited instruction ranges.
direct_kernel_patch_comparison.result: No direct patch anchor within4096bytes of any mapped instruction range; scoped APFS/AMFI/SEPManager/AppleImage4 text ranges and PPL text are disjoint. Global callbacks inspect/write at most0x40 instructions from relevant anchors here, so conservative4096byte exclusion exceeds their reach.
limitations: This is a static direct-patch overlap audit, not a runtime RAM byte comparison.
Boot stderr identifies applied patch names but does not print actual addresses.
Original driver still runs in an emulated platform with patched dependencies; unchanged local instructions do not prove actual execution or notifications.
Other uninspected dynamic state and external userland cache patches are not promoted to equivalent original behavior.
